## Highlights since 0.16.16

- **Add citations without saving the full text.** Adding a paper to a project now saves just its citation by default, so you can cite a paper without downloading its PDF and full text, and adding a batch of papers runs in parallel instead of one at a time.
- **Keep LaTeX auxiliary files out of sight.** A new global setting keeps the `.aux`, `.log` and other files LaTeX writes in a hidden `.research/build` folder instead of next to your sources. Thanks to @dromeroc for the request (#890).
- **A Bibliography layout.** A new layout preset puts the bibliography beside your document, and each layout remembers which document it had open.

## Notable fixes

- Visual mode renders figures, tables and the title block, and shows what citations and references point to so you can jump there.
- LaTeX formatting buttons toggle formatting off again instead of nesting another command.
- You can delete a project's main `.tex` document.
- Linux: an open project no longer rescans itself three times a second, and shortcuts read Ctrl+Shift+J instead of ⌘⇧J.
